visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A hand reaches toward a white and grey pet carrier on a light wood floor. The background shows an office with wooden panels and a wire cage. (2) The door of the carrier opens, and a sleek black cat steps out cautiously, licking its lips. (3) The camera follows the cat as it walks toward a large brown litter tray inside a wire enclosure. (4) The cat enters the litter tray, sniffs around briefly, and walks back out toward a person sitting cross-legged on the floor in jeans and a white t-shirt. (5) The cat leans against the person's legs, and hands gently scratch the cat's neck and back. (6) The cat returns to the litter box and rolls around frantically in the light grey litter, kicking its legs and flipping its body. (7) The cat walks out, looks back at the person, then dives back into the litter for another vigorous roll. (8) The cat exits the enclosure and walks across a wooden desk cluttered with computer monitors, keyboards, cables, and a silver Apple Mac Mini. (9) The cat sits still on the desk, looking directly into the camera with wide yellow eyes. (10) The video ends with a pink screen showing the brand logo.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with low-level room tone and ambient movement. A distinct metallic click of a carrier latch triggers a new phase. (2) A bright, mid-tempo acoustic guitar melody begins. A female voice speaks warmly, welcoming the cat. (3) Continuous rustling and shuffling sounds indicate the cat moving and rolling in litter. The voice laughs with a rising pitch contour. (4) The shuffling sound intensifies as the cat rolls vigorously. The BGM maintains a steady, rhythmic guitar strumming. (5) A loud, sharp meow from the cat punctuates the audio track. The speaker responds with an exaggerated, comedic tone. (6) The BGM continues through the desk-walking sequence, concluding with a light melodic resolved jingle at the end screen.
